tdx-quote.bin
tdx-quote-collateral.json

Vendored verbatim from dcap-qvl 0.6.1, files `sample/tdx_quote` and
`sample/tdx_quote_collateral.json`:

    https://github.com/Phala-Network/dcap-qvl

They are a real Intel TDX attestation quote captured off real hardware and
the Intel-issued collateral bundle for that platform. They are used by
`src/gateway/verify.rs`'s tests because a fabricated quote cannot carry a
PCK certificate chain, so FMSPC extraction and full-chain verification are
unreachable without a genuine one.

The collateral bundle's TCB info and QE identity were issued 2025-06-19 and
expire 2025-07-19. Verification against it only succeeds with the clock
pinned inside that window; see `NOW_INSIDE_COLLATERAL_WINDOW`.
